A Little About Me

I spend my days designing websites and digital experiences, and my nights hanging out with my cats, gaming, or obsessing over something creative, whether it's the latest animated TV show or doodling something on my iPad! I love what I do because it lets me mix storytelling, problem-solving, and a little bit of art into something people actually get to use. I'm drawn to clean but bold visuals, intuitive UX, and projects that make me think. I'd love to creatively obsess over your next project with you! :)
